issue_context.title: Improve scheduler logging
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:
1) Increase the log level of info logs to "v=2" when the scheduler [adds](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8c8c4113f045a00bee611594e402dee07600812b/pkg/scheduler/internal/cache/node_tree.go#L93) or [deletes](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8c8c4113f045a00bee611594e402dee07600812b/pkg/scheduler/internal/cache/node_tree.go#L113) a node from its cache.

2) Increase the log level of info logs to "v=2" when the scheduler can't schedule a pod [1](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8c8c4113f045a00bee611594e402dee07600812b/pkg/scheduler/factory/factory.go#L656), [2](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8c8c4113f045a00bee611594e402dee07600812b/pkg/scheduler/factory/factory.go#L659), and add a log message for [not found errors](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8c8c4113f045a00bee611594e402dee07600812b/pkg/scheduler/factory/factory.go#L660)
2) report memory/cpu status of [the node that a pod get scheduled on](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/df0a99ad354e5e458a123a2ba5f8bd95c34660c0/pkg/scheduler/scheduler.go#L608).

 
**Why is this needed**:
With cluster autoscaler now being used in production by some vendors, we want to have more visibility to events that could be related to the auto scaler to help debug customer issues.

/sig scheduling
/priority important-soon
/assign @liu-cong

review_comments: what does "waiting" at the end mean?
waiting for the pod to be scheduled, you can find "waiting" in similar logs on Line 656 and L659.
Status is a struct object who will have default values, see [code](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/staging/src/k8s.io/api/core/v1/types.go#L4557)
Is the Warning level sufficient? Or this line of error logs can be deleted because the error has been returned.
I guess it doesn't hurt to log an error here for debugging purposes, otherwise we have to rely on the caller to log a proper error message somewhere.

I rather prefer that an error is only logged once. Otherwise it's hard to tell whether an error is unique or not. Could you please check if errors returned from this function are properly logged at some point? If so, this line could be removed.
ha, the error is just ignored... I am going to fix it.
I think it's a pattern to log an error message in the source of error. Otherwise it's hard to enforce all callers to log a proper error message. I will leave the error message here.
